mapper.select: SELECT BANNER_ID, TITLE, IMAGE_DIR, LINK_URL, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM MAIN_SLIDE_IMAGE ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, CDATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS productPrice, P.BRAND, P.SELL_COUNT, (SELECT A.IMG_PATH FROM (SELECT IMG_PATH, PRODUCT_IMG_NO FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY PRODUCT_IMG_NO ASC) A WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS imgPath -- 인라인 뷰로 감싸서 ORDER BY와 ROWNUM을 함께 사용 FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.QUANTITY > 0 ORDER BY P.SELL_COUNT DESC, P.UDATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.RALLY_NO, R.RALLY_NAME, R.RALLY_DATE, R.APPLICATION_PERIOD, R.PRICE AS rallyPrice, R.HOST, (SELECT A.IMG_PATH FROM (SELECT IMG_PATH, RALLY_IMG_NO FROM RALLY_IMG WHERE RALLY_NO = R.RALLY_NO ORDER BY RALLY_IMG_NO ASC) A WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS imgPath -- 인라인 뷰로 감싸서 ORDER BY와 ROWNUM을 함께 사용 FROM RALLY R WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN R.APPLICATION_PERIOD AND R.RALLY_DATE ORDER BY R.RALLY_DATE ASC, R.CDATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT IMG_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY PRODUCT_IMG_NO ASC
SELECT IMG_PATH FROM RALLY_IMG WHERE RALLY_NO = #{rallyNo} AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY RALLY_IMG_NO ASC
